scope: Uncommitted G1 repair-cycle-3 static review for branch benchmark/v5-g1-uv-version-parse, limited to the minimal TASK-OSS-09 uv version parsing change and its static regression validator. No workflow dispatch, no evidence rewrites, no READY claim, no commit, and no push.

independentChecks.name: minimal_change_scope
independentChecks.details: The pre-review worktree diff is limited to the workflow file and the static workflow validator. No prior attempt-3 artifact, dispatch evidence, test fixture, lockfile, or control JSON was modified by this repair patch.

independentChecks.name: ubuntu_suffix_mismatch_fixed
independentChecks.details: The observed failure evidence from Saturday, August 1, 2026 recorded uv_version=uv 0.11.8 (x86_64-unknown-linux-gnu) at the exact runtime-version-check phase. The repair now captures uv --version once, preserves the full output for diagnostics/runtime_uv, and validates only the first two fields so the observed Ubuntu suffix mismatch is accepted without weakening the version pin.

independentChecks.name: uv_0_11_8_requirement_retained
independentChecks.details: The runtime gate still requires uv 0.11.8 exactly. The change narrows the comparison to the first two fields of the full uv output; it does not permit a different version number.

independentChecks.name: full_uv_output_retained
independentChecks.details: The patch retains the full uv output string in both the diagnostics artifact and runtime_uv instead of truncating it to the parsed prefix.

independentChecks.name: static_regression_rejects_brittle_full_string_assertion
independentChecks.details: The validator now requires the tolerant uv capture and first-two-fields check, explicitly rejects the old exact full-string assertion, and includes a negative mutation that fails if that brittle assertion is restored.

independentChecks.name: no_install_test_cache_network_credential_ready_oracle_lock_threshold_change
independentChecks.details: No install/test/cache/network/credential/READY/task/oracle/lock/threshold behavior changed in this repair. The only workflow hunk changes are uv capture, tolerant version comparison, and reusing the captured full string. The surrounding install, uv sync, lock immutability, pytest, cache-root emission, and runtime capture flow is unchanged, and the validator still enforces the existing credential, network, lock, and READY boundaries.

independentChecks.name: prior_attempt_3_failure_evidence_immutable
independentChecks.details: The prior attempt-3 failure evidence remained outside the repair diff, and the recomputed hashes for the key dispatch and TASK-OSS-09 failure files match the preserved review inputs collected before writing this Sol review.

independentChecks.name: targeted_validators_pass
independentChecks.details: The targeted validators for the workflow and shell assumptions pass against the repaired worktree, the updated validator parses successfully, and git diff --check reports no formatting damage.

independentChecks.name: full_npm_ci_honestly_blocked_by_180s_governance_hang
independentChecks.details: A fresh local full CI run wrapped by an independent 180-second alarm timed out rather than completing. The captured log shows progress through check, validate, validate:runtime-proof, and partial test:governance output before stalling with no further progress, so full npm ci is honestly BLOCKED instead of misreported as passing.

validated.failurePath: The static regression rejects reverting to the brittle exact full-string uv assertion.

The 180-second local npm run ci timeout is an existing governance-runner blocker outside the scope of this minimal uv version parsing repair.
